src/lib/record-rental-transport.server.t.justification: Previous pin 1762071545760c15b0859ec13ca14e9d93d58d2f2a8b1ac10fb3c4981d794823. 1f341899 replaces caller-supplied SQL text with a fixed operation list (snapshot, issue, bind, identity, recover, licenseSnapshot, verifyLicense), each bound to its database role, and adds the HMAC-signed evidence gateway (proposed/record-rental-gateway) for the same fixed operations. The gateway key is server-held; scripts/record-rental-client-bundle.test.mjs proves it is absent from client chunks. Reviewed in the Record Rental integration branch.

src/lib/record-rental.functions.ts.justification: Previous pin f57639a3582312995c24a12db1d9d853da5abf20dc2416aa99bc4bb1673e3ed7. 3106b348 connects the runtime: after the unchanged disabled-flag check, the Manager check and the bearer check, the handler builds the server-owned resources (ensureRecordRentalResources) before taking the transport. Reviewed in the Record Rental integration branch.
